protocol.success: Primary flight metric: fraction of episodes with reward at least 200.
protocol.accuracy: Secondary teacher-action agreement on the original held-out demonstration episodes; stored as action_accuracy for compatibility, not a measure of flight success.
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Final checkpoint of each named run, not a selected peak.
protocol.comparison: Practical configurations with settings recorded per row; one training run per row.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap across evaluation flights: 10000 resamples, RNG seed42, percentile95 interval; not training-run uncertainty.
